sunsetting_policy.humanNotices: Manual one-off operator broadcasts only (/admin or scripts/broadcast.mjs); automated release entries never target human UI banners.

entries.title: Cloudflare Realtime SFU/TURN, plan headroom APIs & self-hosting
entries.summary: Added hybrid P2P/SFU call transport (shared/media/sfu-transport.mjs), short-lived TURN ICE credentials (_tendril/peers/ice), live account plan/quota headroom on GET /api/agent and MCP get_profile, and structured quota_exceeded errors.
entries.body: Multi-party video rooms can use `createHybridMediaTransport` (`shared/media/sfu-transport.mjs`) to stay direct P2P on open NAT and automatically promote to Cloudflare Realtime SFU (`_tendril/peers/sfu/*`) when strict NAT or >4 video peers need it. Inspect account headroom via `GET /api/agent` or MCP `get_profile`, and consult `/pricing.md` or `/self-host.md` whenever a `429`/`413` `quota_exceeded` error is returned.

entries.title: Outbound OAuth connections & GitHub/Google org admission
entries.summary: Added Tier A (agent-held, X25519-sealed) and Tier B (host-brokered, client-wrapped) outbound OAuth connections plus admin-signed GitHub Org/Team and Google Workspace group admission with automatic offboarding.
entries.body: Use `@tendriller/core/connections`, `shared/helpers/connections.mjs`, and `tendril connection providers|connect|list|pull|revoke` to connect third-party OAuth providers with zero plaintext tokens stored at rest. Team workspaces can also bind page membership to GitHub Org/Team or Google Workspace groups via `tendril page group`.

entries.title: Breaking upgrade: Chronolog v2 Merkle-DAG reducers, chronolog/sql (SQLite-CAS), pluggable authority & zero native builds
entries.summary: Chronolog v2 replaces v1 authority/genesis, DoltLite, better-sqlite3, and separate domain.js bundles with hash-pinned in-chain QuickJS-NG ES Module $reducers, deterministic Merkle-paged SQLite-CAS (chronolog/sql + write RLS), and pluggable $permissions (--authority attested|multisig|open). Pre-v2 pages and local device stores cannot be migrated in place and must be recreated.
entries.body: Action required for all existing workspaces and agents: (1) Upgrade to Node 22.15+ and install the latest pinned `firstApp.release` kit with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` (zero native C/C++ builds). (2) Recreate pages under Chronolog v2 (`npm run page:new`, `npm run init`, `npm run deploy`); pre-v2 pages, browser profiles, and `.tendriller/` device stores will not open under v2. (3) For SQL apps, bind topics directly to built-in `chronolog/sql` (declarative SQLite + FTS5 + sqlite-vec with atomic `preconditions`/`postconditions`, Postgres-style write RLS via `chronolog/rls`, and `{ query: 'schema' }` introspection) instead of DoltLite/MySQL DDL. (4) For custom reducers, ship pure ES Modules in `$reducers` and check capabilities via `ctx.query('$permissions', { check, actor })`; pass `--authority attested|multisig|open` to `setup.mjs init` to choose host-attested, M-of-N multisig, or open membership. Browser workers must compile and pass `wasmModule` (QuickJS-NG) and `sqliteWasmModule` (`sqlite-cas.wasm` for SQL pages) — already wired in the `notes`, `inventory`, and `call` templates.
